definitions: A prominent companion of the Islamic prophet Muhammad.
He was the chief scribe of the Quran and played a crucial role in its compilation.
Known for his expertise in Islamic law, inheritance, and the Arabic language.
examples: Zayd ibn Thabit was entrusted with the task of compiling the Quran.
Many narrations about the Prophet Muhammad were transmitted by Zayd ibn Thabit.
The companions recognized Zayd ibn Thabit's exceptional memory and knowledge.
